GIC-Based Variable Selection

Source: R/GICSelection.R
GICSelection.Rd

Performs variable selection using the Generalized Information Criterion (GIC) with Hopfield Network optimization. The computationally intensive components are implemented in 'Julia' for performance, while an 'R' interface provides user-friendly access.

Usage

GICSelection(X, Y, Initial_Column, Calculate_GIC, Calculate_GIC_short, k,
             Nsim = 1L, gamma = 0.6)

Arguments

X

Numeric design matrix (n x p), where n is the number of observations and p is the number of predictors.

Y

Numeric response (either a vector of length n or a matrix with n rows).

Initial_Column

Integer vector of initial feature indices to consider.

Calculate_GIC

Character name of the 'Julia' function for full GIC calculation.

Calculate_GIC_short

Character name of the matching _short 'Julia' function. Kept for backward compatibility; the built-in criteria use fast rank-one updates instead.

k

Integer model-size cap: a move that would give a model with k or more variables is skipped. Models also never exceed \(n - 1\) variables (\(n\) = sample size), so selected models have at most min(k, n) - 1 variables.

Nsim

Integer number of passes over the variables, each in a new random order (default: 1).

gamma

EBIC tuning constant \(\gamma\) (default 0.6); ignored by other criteria.

Value

A list containing:

  • GIC_values: Calculated GIC values for all candidate models

  • selected_coeffs: Indices of selected variables

Details

This function implements a variable selection algorithm that:

  • Uses customizable information criteria (such as AIC, BIC, and ICOMP)

  • Leverages a 'Julia' backend for computational efficiency

  • Supports various model families, including generalized linear models (GLMs) such as the normal and Poisson families

  • Accepts both univariate and multivariate responses

References

Xiao, Y. and Walker, S. G. (2026). Fast variable selection under \(\ell_0\) regularization in high-dimensions. Statistics and Computing, 36(3), 100. doi:10.1007/s11222-026-10853-5

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
if (requireNamespace("JuliaCall", quietly = TRUE)) {
  julia_available <- FALSE
  tryCatch({
    JuliaCall::julia_setup(installJulia = FALSE)
    julia_available <- TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Julia not available: ", e$message)
  })

  if (julia_available) {
    set.seed(123)
    n <- 100; p <- 10; k <- 3
    X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
    beta <- c(rep(1.5, k), rep(0, p - k))
    Y_uni <- LP_to_Y(X, beta, family = "Normal", std = 1.0)

    result_uni <- GICSelection(
      X = X,
      Y = Y_uni,
      Initial_Column = 1:p,
      Calculate_GIC = "Calculate_SIC",
      Calculate_GIC_short = "Calculate_SIC_short",
      k = 3,
      Nsim = 3
    )
    print(result_uni$selected_coeffs)

    m <- 3
    multi_beta <- matrix(0, p, m)
    multi_beta[1:3, ] <- 1
    rho <- 0.2
    cov_p <- matrix(rho, nrow = m, ncol = m)
    diag(cov_p) <- 1.0
    Y_multi <- LP_to_Y(X, multi_beta, family = "MultivariateNormal", cov_matrix = cov_p)

    result_multi <- GICSelection(
      X = X,
      Y = Y_multi,
      Initial_Column = 1:p,
      Calculate_GIC = "Calculate_SIC",
      Calculate_GIC_short = "Calculate_SIC_short",
      k = 3,
      Nsim = 3
    )
    print(result_multi$selected_coeffs)
  }
}
} # }
